args.title: Persist chosen export format across page loads
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Currently the `format` state always initializes to the `defaultFormat` ("csv") with no persistence. Store the user's selected export format (e.g. in localStorage) and initialize the `format` state from that stored value, updating storage whenever the selection changes.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This file initializes the export format state to a hardcoded "csv" default with no persistent storage read or write, so the selection always resets on page load, matching the reporter's complaint. Persisting the chosen format (e.g. via localStorage) and initializing state from it would address this.
